capabilities.label: Stock / Hybrid Short
capabilities.best_for: Approved narration with relevant real or licensed footage.
capabilities.avoid: Historical reconstructions needing exact characters or locations; silhouette quizzes.
capabilities.next_step: Install isolated runtime; review assets and narration; connect durable worker before studio rendering.

capabilities.label: Animated Explanation
capabilities.best_for: Cause and effect, comparisons and verified quantity changes inside any compatible story.
capabilities.avoid: Treating a template as an arbitrary-topic text-to-video model.
capabilities.next_step: Preview the authored template; export PNG frames; encode and inspect before assembly.

capabilities.label: Remix to Shorts
capabilities.best_for: Self-contained excerpts from owned or licensed finished videos.
capabilities.avoid: Face tracking on illustrated scenes; automatic publishing; interpreting a clip score as retention.
capabilities.next_step: Select a source and complete hook-to-payoff span; reuse transcript and review framing.

capabilities.label: Shared Storyboard
capabilities.best_for: Before / change / after shot planning, continuity and ViMax shot-description imports.
capabilities.avoid: Importing ViMax audio descriptions as narration or treating imported plans as approvals.
capabilities.next_step: Edit locally, export JSON, validate with python -m bolt_video.engines validate.
